title: Air through the data hall, and the heat it carries
alt: A face-on section cut across four rows of a data hall. From left to right: a cold aisle, a rack, an enclosed hot aisle, an in-row cooler, a cold aisle, a rack, an enclosed hot aisle, an in-row cooler and a cold aisle. Arrows show cool air going into the rack fronts, hot air out the backs into the enclosed hot aisle, through the in-row cooler and back out cool. Pipes from each cooler carry warm water out of the hall.

steps.caption: A data hall in section: cold aisles and enclosed hot aisles take turns.
Cool air goes in the front of each rack and comes out the back hot.
The hot aisle is closed in, so hot air can only leave through the cooler.
The in-row cooler puts the heat into water and sends cool air back out.
The warm water leaves the hall for the heat-recovery room.
